title: Te Kaihanga o te Hiahia Hē
intro: I mua, i mahi tētahi tangata whai mana nui ki tētahi o ngā kaitukino rongonui o te hītori o Īhipa onamata. I tukua ki tēnei tangata tētahi whakahau māia - ki te hanga i tētahi hanganga hei whakakeke i ngā rangi. Ko tā rātou kōrero i roto i te Quran he akoranga whakamiharo mō te pehea e arahi ai te ngohengohe matapo ki te whakapehapeha ki te whakangaromanga.
clues: I mahi ahau i roto i ngā kōti o tētahi rangatira kaha i kī ko ia te atua o te whenua.
I noho ahau i tētahi tūranga minita nui, hei kaitohutohu i te kaitukino whakakake rawa atu o tōku wā.
I whakapau kaha tōku rangatira ki te wero i te Atua o Mohi, i whakakahoretia nei e rātou.
I whakahaua ahau kia hanga he pourewa ki ngā pereki i tunua ki te ahi kia taea ai e taku rangatira te piki ki te rangi.
Kāore te pourewa i tae ki te rangi, ā, nā taku pononga ki te whakapehapeha ahau i whakama ai ake ake.
I mate tahi māua ko te tangata i aru ahau, ā, ko tōku ingoa hei whakatūpato pumau mō te hunga e whakamana ana i ngā kaitukino.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Hāmana
Azar (matua o Ibrahim)
Ilias (he poropiti)
Dhu al-Kifl
Harut (tetahi o ngā anahera tokorua i Papurona)

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I whakahaua kia hanga he whare tiketike hei eke ki te rangi
I tonoa kia whakamārama i tētahi moemoeā i tukuna mai e te atua
Ka maka ki roto i te ahi mura hei whakamātautau i te whakapono
I akiakihia kia whiriwhiri i waenga i te torona me te pono
I whakataetaehia i roto i te whakataetae makutu
trial.answer: I whakahaua kia hanga he whare tiketike hei eke ki te rangi

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: He pourewa pereki i tunua ki te ahi
He tokotoko i huri hei nakahi
He kaipuke e rere ana i roto i te waipuke nui
He māra e karapotia ana e ngā taiepa teitei
He torona kua whakapaipaihia ki ngā rupi me te koura
location.answer: He pourewa pereki i tunua ki te ahi

outcome.label: Hua
options: I toremi i te taha o te kaitukino i te moana
I noho hei kingi mana nui mō ngā whenua whānui
I mawhiti mai i te mura ahi, kāore i whara
I hanga he kingitanga whai rawa o te whakaaro nui
I tūtaki anō ki te whānau i muri i ngā tau o te noho manene
outcome.answer: I toremi i te taha o te kaitukino i te moana

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (40:23)
